title: Melted plastic on burner
text: Melted plastic on burner. Yes it works but the set up was frustrating. As we took out all the pieces and plastic we discovered that it must have been turned on at some point prior to it being sent to us and plastic had melted onto the heating element. After picking at the plastic for quite some time we then had to basically cook the remaining plastic off which really stunk and took a while before we could even use it. Once everything was in working order we have used it and it air fried chicken wonderfully.

product_metadata.title: PINSOON 10-Quart Air Fryer, Rotisserie Shaft & Layer Racks & Nonstick Basket, Electric Hot Air Fryer Oven Oilless Cooker, 12 Accessories, 8 Cooking Presets, LED Digital Touchscreen 50 Recipes

360° Hot Air Convection – This innovative air fryer uses full circle heated cyclonic system and offers classic rotisserie movement to help cook food more efficiently throughout to create crispier exteriors but retain juice, food-safe interiors.

Smart operation: 8 cooking presets can satisfy most cooking needs and help food to cook more evenly. The selection at a touch rather than keeps circling to make a choice, With a wide temperature range from 120℉ to 400℉, time control from 1-60 minutes. This air cooker allows you to air fry, bake, grill, roast, toast, dehydrate and rotisserie

Smarter Meals with an Air Fryer XL – A large, versatile hot air fryer, you can cut out fats, oils, and other unhealthy additives to reduce carbs, stick to a smarter diet plan, and still enjoy your favorite fried, roasted, and rotisserie foods.

Complimentary Recipe Cookbook – Every kitchen deserves a few great recipes to help get started, which is why we’ve also included 50 healthy recipes with our oilless air fryer oven. It’s time to eat better without giving up your favorites.
